personas.relevant_history: Grew up with emotionally distant parents and experienced several unstable relationships in early adulthood. Recently ended a tumultuous relationship marked by emotional highs and lows.
personas.situation: Got into an argument with a close friend who didn't respond to her messages for a day.
intermediate_beliefs: If someone doesn’t reply right away, they must be rejecting me
I need constant reassurance to feel safe
automatic_thoughts: I must have done something wrong again
behaviors: Blocked and unblocked the friend several times
Cried and stayed in bed all day
coping_strategies: Testing others’ loyalty through impulsive actions

personas.relevant_history: Was emotionally and physically abused by a caregiver during childhood. Struggles with chronic feelings of emptiness and fear of being alone. Currently unemployed and feels disconnected from peers.
personas.situation: Was not invited to a coworker’s birthday gathering posted on social media.
core_beliefs: No one truly cares about me
intermediate_beliefs: If people don’t include me, I must be hated
automatic_thoughts: They left me out on purpose
behaviors: Posted a vague, self-deprecating status on social media
coping_strategies: Maladaptive use of alcohol to numb emotions
